s108-road-native.mts.source: import {loadLevel} from '/Users/wesner/Workspace/minorincident/.claude/worktrees/s108-leftovers/tools/sim-runner/levels.ts';import {cure} from '/Users/wesner/Workspace/minorincident/.claude/worktrees/s108-leftovers/src/levels/L10/district.ts';import {writeFileSync} from 'node:fs';const rows=[];for(const tier of ['high','low'] as const){const w=await loadLevel('L10',3,undefined,0,{quality:tier});const crops=w.districts!.districts.flatMap(d=>d.decay.placements.filter(p=>p.assetId==='veg.corn-block'));const samples=[];for(const r of cure.regions.slice(5))for(let i=1;i<r.route.length;i++){const a=r.route[i-1],b=r.route[i],len=Math.hypot(b[0]-a[0],b[1]-a[1]);for(let n=0;n<=Math.ceil(len);n++){const t=n/Math.ceil(len),x=a[0]+t*(b[0]-a[0]),z=a[1]+t*(b[1]-a[1]);const clearance=Math.min(...crops.map(p=>Math.hypot(Math.max(p.visualAabb.min[0]-x,0,x-p.visualAabb.max[0]),Math.max(p.visualAabb.min[2]-z,0,z-p.visualAabb.max[2]))));samples.push({region:r.id,x,z,ground:w.districts!.groundHeight(x,z),clearance});}}rows.push({tier,crops:crops.length,samples,minimumCropClearance:Math.min(...samples.map(p=>p.clearance)),finiteGround:samples.every(p=>Number.isFinite(p.ground))});w.dispose();}writeFileSync('test-results/s108-leftovers/road-native.json',JSON.stringify(rows));console.log(rows.map(r=>({tier:r.tier,n:r.samples.length,crops:r.crops,min:r.minimumCropClearance,ground:r.finiteGround})));
